meta.name: The Happening
meta.description: When a deadly airborne virus threatens to wipe out the northeastern United States, teacher Elliot Moore and his wife Alma flee from contaminated cities into the countryside in a fight to discover the truth. Is it terrorism, the accidental release of some toxic military bio weapon -- or something even more sinister?
meta.slogan: We've sensed it. We've seen the signs. Now...it's happening.
